title: makecindy/cindy
title_zh: Cindy 开源 AI 智能体

paragraphs.en: Consider it done. The open-source AI agent that works out of the box · 想到，就能做到。开源、开箱即用的 AI Agent。
paragraphs.zh: 交给我，包您满意。 开箱即用的开源 AI 智能体 · 想到，就能做到。开源、开箱即用的 AI 智能体。

sents.en: Consider it done.
sents.zh: 交给我，包您满意。

sents.en: The open-source AI agent that works out of the box · 想到，就能做到。开源、开箱即用的 AI Agent。
sents.zh: 开箱即用的开源 AI 智能体 · 想到，就能做到。开源、开箱即用的 AI 智能体。

paragraphs.en: Cindy is an open-source AI agent that works out of the box. She brings multiple harnesses, models and tools into one agent that finishes real work in your projects and apps. Ready from day one, yours to shape over time.
paragraphs.zh: Cindy 是一个开箱即用的开源智能体。 她将多种运行框架、模型和工具整合到一个智能体中，能在你的项目和应用中完成真正的工作。 第一天即可使用，随时间由你塑造。

sents.en: Cindy is an open-source AI agent that works out of the box.
sents.zh: Cindy 是一个开箱即用的开源智能体。

sents.en: She brings multiple harnesses, models and tools into one agent that finishes real work in your projects and apps.
sents.zh: 她将多种运行框架、模型和工具整合到一个智能体中，能在你的项目和应用中完成真正的工作。

sents.en: Ready from day one, yours to shape over time.
sents.zh: 第一天即可使用，随时间由你塑造。

paragraphs.en: Cindy runs locally on your own machine, using your real files and logged-in apps. The first supported harnesses are Claude Code and Codex — more are being added, and a native harness is in the works. Models and harnesses mix freely and can switch mid-task while your workspace, memory, skills and tools stay continuous; one task can even be planned, executed in parallel, and reviewed by agents on different harness × model combos. She can drive your browser, computer and phone, and take work from IM and schedules.
paragraphs.zh: Cindy 在你自己的机器上本地运行，使用你的真实文件和已登录的应用。 首批支持的框架是 Claude Code 和 Codex——更多框架正在加入中，原生框架也在开发之中。 模型与框架可以自由组合，并且能在任务中途切换，而你的工作区、记忆、技能和工具保持连续；一个任务甚至可以由处于不同「框架 × 模型」组合上的智能体分别进行规划、并行执行和审查。 她可以操控你的浏览器、电脑和手机，并处理来自即时通讯软件和日程安排的工作。

sents.en: Cindy runs locally on your own machine, using your real files and logged-in apps.
sents.zh: Cindy 在你自己的机器上本地运行，使用你的真实文件和已登录的应用。

sents.en: The first supported harnesses are Claude Code and Codex — more are being added, and a native harness is in the works.
sents.zh: 首批支持的框架是 Claude Code 和 Codex——更多框架正在加入中，原生框架也在开发之中。

sents.en: Models and harnesses mix freely and can switch mid-task while your workspace, memory, skills and tools stay continuous; one task can even be planned, executed in parallel, and reviewed by agents on different harness × model combos.
sents.zh: 模型与框架可以自由组合，并且能在任务中途切换，而你的工作区、记忆、技能和工具保持连续；一个任务甚至可以由处于不同「框架 × 模型」组合上的智能体分别进行规划、并行执行和审查。

sents.en: She can drive your browser, computer and phone, and take work from IM and schedules.
sents.zh: 她可以操控你的浏览器、电脑和手机，并处理来自即时通讯软件和日程安排的工作。

paragraphs.en: This repository is the open-source client for Cindy — the desktop and mobile apps plus their shared packages, organized as a pnpm monorepo.
paragraphs.zh: 本仓库是 Cindy 的开源客户端——包括桌面端和移动端应用及其共享包，以 pnpm monorepo 的形式组织。

paragraphs.en: The client is free to use, and its source code is open under Apache-2.0. Bring models your way: sign in to the official Cindy service (usage deducted transparently), authorize the Claude Code / Codex Coding Plan you already pay for and keep using it inside Cindy — no duplicate bill — connect your own API keys, or use local models. See cindy.app for service details, pricing , and downloads .
paragraphs.zh: 该客户端可免费使用，其源代码以 Apache-2.0 许可证开源。 按你想要的方式接入模型：登录官方 Cindy 服务（用量透明扣费），授权你已付费的 Claude Code / Codex Coding Plan 并继续在 Cindy 中使用——无需重复付费——连接你自己的 API 密钥，或使用本地模型。 有关服务详情、定价和下载，请访问 cindy.app。

sents.en: The client is free to use, and its source code is open under Apache-2.0.

paragraphs.en: Linux users: see the Ubuntu, Arch Linux and Omarchy installation guide for installation, updates, keyring setup and migration from a manual install.
paragraphs.zh: Linux 用户：请参阅 Ubuntu、Arch Linux 和 Omarchy 安装指南，了解安装、更新、密钥环设置以及从手动安装迁移的相关内容。

paragraphs.en: Open source means more than visible — it means changeable:
paragraphs.zh: 开源不仅仅意味着可见——更意味着可修改：

paragraphs.en: Ready out of the box, never boxed in — start with CONTRIBUTING.en.md and build Cindy with us.
paragraphs.zh: 开箱即用，从不受限——从 CONTRIBUTING.en.md 开始，与我们一起构建 Cindy。

paragraphs.en: Not in this repo: the backend service lives in a separate repository and is not part of this monorepo.
paragraphs.zh: 不在此仓库中：后端服务位于单独的仓库中，不属于此 monorepo 的一部分。

paragraphs.en: Contributor setup, Git LFS, dependency updates, and access requirements are maintained in CONTRIBUTING.en.md . Plugins are installed through SkillHub or manually.
paragraphs.zh: 贡献者配置、Git LFS、依赖更新与访问要求均维护于 CONTRIBUTING.en.md 中。 插件可通过 SkillHub 安装或手动安装。

sents.en: Contributor setup, Git LFS, dependency updates, and access requirements are maintained in CONTRIBUTING.en.md .
sents.zh: 贡献者配置、Git LFS、依赖更新与访问要求均维护于 CONTRIBUTING.en.md 中。

sents.en: Plugins are installed through SkillHub or manually.
sents.zh: 插件可通过 SkillHub 安装或手动安装。

paragraphs.en: git clone https://github.com/makecindy/cindy.git cd cindy git lfs pull pnpm install Development entry points # Mainland China Cindy account pnpm restart:desktop:remote --region=cn # Global Cindy account pnpm restart:desktop:remote --region=global Remote development uses your own Cindy cloud account and existing login state, so you can continue existing sessions and work while developing the client. Use cn for Mainland China accounts and global for everyone else; do not rely on the internal default. Full desktop, mobile, data-isolation, and validation workflows are in CONTRIBUTING.en.md .
paragraphs.zh: git clone https://github.com/makecindy/cindy.git cd cindy git lfs pull pnpm install 开发入口 # 中国大陆 Cindy 账户 pnpm restart:desktop:remote --region=cn # 全球 Cindy 账户 pnpm restart:desktop:remote --region=global 远程开发使用你自己的 Cindy 云账户和现有登录状态，因此你可以在开发客户端的同时继续现有的会话和工作。 中国大陆账户使用 cn，其他所有账户使用 global；不要依赖内部默认值。 完整的桌面端、移动端、数据隔离和验证工作流见 CONTRIBUTING.en.md 。

sents.zh: 中国大陆账户使用 cn，其他所有账户使用 global；不要依赖内部默认值。

sents.en: Full desktop, mobile, data-isolation, and validation workflows are in CONTRIBUTING.en.md .
sents.zh: 完整的桌面端、移动端、数据隔离和验证工作流见 CONTRIBUTING.en.md 。

paragraphs.en: “Skip Sign-In” on the login screen runs local agents without a Cindy account (shown in the app as “Not signed in”), not a connection to a local server. Server-backed capabilities are unavailable in this state.
paragraphs.zh: 登录界面上的「跳过登录」选项可在没有 Cindy 账户的情况下运行本地智能体（应用中显示为「未登录」），而不是连接到本地服务器。 在此状态下，依赖服务器支持的功能不可用。

sents.zh: 登录界面上的「跳过登录」选项可在没有 Cindy 账户的情况下运行本地智能体（应用中显示为「未登录」），而不是连接到本地服务器。

paragraphs.en: About the default servers: the client connects to Cindy's official cloud services by default (endpoint manifests in config/endpoint.json and config/endpoint.global.json ; desktop auto-updates also come from the official CDN). This is intentional — external developers don't need to self-host a server: sign in with your own Cindy account in a dev build and develop / test directly against the official servers.
paragraphs.zh: 关于默认服务器：客户端默认连接 Cindy 官方云服务（端点清单位于 config/endpoint.json 和 config/endpoint.global.json 中；桌面端自动更新也来自官方 CDN）。 这是有意为之的——外部开发者无需自行部署服务器：在开发版本中使用你自己的 Cindy 账号登录，即可直接连接官方服务器进行开发与测试。

paragraphs.en: Skill Hub migration uses two separate manifest fields: released clients keep using skillhubApiBaseUrl (the deprecated XD proxy), while current clients use cindySkillHubApiBaseUrl . The current client deliberately does not fall back to the legacy field when the new endpoint is absent.
paragraphs.zh: Skill Hub 迁移使用两个独立的清单字段：已发布的客户端继续使用 skillhubApiBaseUrl（已弃用的 XD 代理），而当前客户端使用 cindySkillHubApiBaseUrl。 当新端点不存在时，当前客户端刻意不会回退到旧字段。

paragraphs.en: Contributions go through pull requests into main . Read CONTRIBUTING.en.md first, then use .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md . Every commit needs a Developer Certificate of Origin sign-off ( git commit -s ); a DCO check on each pull request enforces it, and no CLA is required. Please also follow CODE_OF_CONDUCT.en.md . For ordinary usage questions, see SUPPORT.en.md ; report security issues privately through SECURITY.en.md .
paragraphs.zh: 贡献通过拉取请求合入 main 分支。 请先阅读 CONTRIBUTING.en.md ，然后使用 .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md 。 每次提交都需要开发者来源证明签署（ git commit -s ）；每个拉取请求上的 DCO 检查会强制执行此要求，且无需签署 CLA。 请同时遵守 CODE_OF_CONDUCT.en.md 。 有关一般使用问题，请参阅 SUPPORT.en.md ；安全问题请通过 SECURITY.en.md 私下报告。

paragraphs.en: Official distribution builds include TapDB usage analytics for product-level aggregate statistics (device / OS / app-version metadata; associated with your account ID after sign-in). It does not collect chat content, file content, or working-directory data. In addition, while signed in to a cloud account the client sends an online heartbeat to Cindy services (account ID, platform, and version only). Crash dumps stay on the local machine and are never uploaded automatically.
paragraphs.zh: 官方发行版构建中包含 TapDB 使用情况分析，用于产品级汇总统计（设备/操作系统/应用版本元数据；登录后与您的账户 ID 关联）。 它不会收集聊天内容、文件内容或工作目录数据。 此外，在登录云账户期间，客户端会向 Cindy 服务发送在线心跳（仅包含账户 ID、平台和版本信息）。 崩溃转储保留在本地计算机上，绝不会自动上传。

sents.en: Official distribution builds include TapDB usage analytics for product-level aggregate statistics (device / OS / app-version metadata; associated with your account ID after sign-in).

sents.en: Crash dumps stay on the local machine and are never uploaded automatically.
sents.zh: 崩溃转储保留在本地计算机上，绝不会自动上传。
